title: Count Frequency Staircase Subarrays II
statement: The problem counts subarrays whose distinct values, in first-appearance order, occur exactly 1, 2, ..., k times, with n up to 5·10^4. Such a subarray has triangular length k(k+1)/2, so k is at most K ≈ sqrt(2n). Brute force extends right from each left end until a count exceeds its rank or the distinct count passes K; each position is reached by at most K+1 scans, giving O(n sqrt n).
